summary: ci_test.sh against private copies of tools/ci/report.sh and bisect.sh, each fault failing its rows

faults.name: report
faults.summary: an unfinished run bisected as a failure of the runner

lines: ci-test: failed: report core unfinished unfinished-core: the row fails

faults.name: cilabel
faults.summary: a filed issue without the label ci

edits.find: if ! url=$(gh issue create --repo "$repo" --title "$title" --label bug --label ci --body "$body"); then
edits.replace: if ! url=$(gh issue create --repo "$repo" --title "$title" --label bug --body "$body"); then

lines: ci-test: failed: report core unfinished unfinished-core: the row fails

faults.name: baseline
faults.summary: a nightly pass not taken for a full run's last pass

edits.find: full) depth=500 contexts="ci/full ci/night" what="Release tests" ;;

lines: ci-test: failed: base: the row fails

faults.name: again
faults.summary: a failure repeated on an intermittent issue not bisected again

lines: ci-test: failed: again bug ci intermittent: the row fails

faults.name: reread
faults.summary: an issue's labels not read again after the report on it

lines: ci-test: failed: again bug ci bug ci intermittent: the row fails

faults.name: verdict
faults.summary: the verdict in a job's outputs ignored when its upload was lost

lines: ci-test: failed: lost: the row fails

faults.name: rerun
faults.summary: a core job that no runner took not started again

lines: ci-test: failed: unrun: the row fails

faults.name: retry
faults.summary: a job lost again on the same commit not reported as unfinished

lines: ci-test: failed: unrun: the row fails

faults.name: record
faults.summary: a lost job not recorded as ci/lost

lines: ci-test: failed: unrun: the row fails

faults.name: hold
faults.summary: the hold issue looked for by its title alone

lines: ci-test: failed: hold fail: the row fails
ci-test: failed: hold pass: the row fails

faults.name: bisect
faults.summary: an unfinished core run bisected as a failure of the runner

lines: ci-test: failed: bisect unfinished-core core 0: the row fails

faults.name: items
faults.summary: the core set run without the other items of a core run that failed

lines: ci-test: failed: bisect style core tests style bad\ntests core bad 0: the row fails

faults.name: comment
faults.summary: a failed comment on the issue not reported

edits.find: { echo "ci: bisect: the comment on #$issue failed" >&2; return 1; }
edits.replace: { echo "ci: bisect: the comment on #$issue failed" >&2; return 0; }

lines: ci-test: failed: bisect unfinished-core core 1 comment: the row fails

faults.name: label
faults.summary: a failed label on the issue not reported

edits.find: { echo "ci: bisect: the label on #$issue failed" >&2; status=1; }
edits.replace: { echo "ci: bisect: the label on #$issue failed" >&2; status=0; }

lines: ci-test: failed: bisect unfinished-core core 0 edit: the row fails

faults.name: intermittent
faults.summary: a failed comment on a failure that passed when run again not reported

edits.find: say "$on: $(short "$bad") passed $failed when run again, so the failure did not repeat. The issue is labelled intermittent and stays open; it loses the label when the failure comes back." || status=1
edits.replace: say "$on: $(short "$bad") passed $failed when run again, so the failure did not repeat. The issue is labelled intermittent and stays open; it loses the label when the failure comes back." || :

lines: ci-test: failed: bisect unfinished-core core 0 comment: the row fails

faults.name: newest
faults.summary: the issue's newest run not taken before labelling it intermittent

lines: ci-test: failed: latest 1 2: the row fails

faults.name: recheck
faults.summary: the issue's newest run not taken again after labelling it intermittent

lines: ci-test: failed: latest 1 1 2: the row fails

faults.name: older
faults.summary: an unfinished full run not repeated as night where run.sh knows only that

lines: ci-test: failed: older: the row fails

faults.name: refusal
faults.summary: a refused run in bisection counted as a failure

lines: ci-test: failed: suite refuse: the row fails

faults.name: limit
faults.summary: a bisection command run without its time limit

lines: ci-test: failed: bisect unfinished-core core 1: the row fails

faults.name: handoff
faults.summary: a bisection that does not continue in a new run

lines: ci-test: failed: handoff: the row fails

faults.name: closed
faults.summary: a bisection whose issue has been closed goes on

lines: ci-test: failed: closed: the row fails

faults.name: rerunctx
faults.summary: a full run of chosen suites sets the statuses of a full run

lines: ci-test: failed: chosen: the row fails

faults.name: skipped
faults.summary: an architecture with nothing to test given a status

lines: ci-test: failed: chosen: the row fails

faults.name: history
faults.summary: a run that listed no failure passes though its history has an attempt that did not pass

lines: ci-test: failed: attempts hidden: the row fails

faults.name: listing
faults.summary: the attempts a history lists are left out of the issue

lines: ci-test: failed: attempts flaky: the row fails

faults.name: unread
faults.summary: a history the reader cannot read is taken for one with no failure

lines: ci-test: failed: attempts unread: the row fails

faults.name: keep
faults.summary: the hold's issues are listed by the label ci, so that a passing run takes an open intermittent issue for the hold

lines: ci-test: failed: attempts kept: the row fails

faults.name: old
faults.summary: a result without history/ is read as if it had one

lines: ci-test: failed: lost: the row fails
